## Install

=== "Claude Code"

    ```text
    /plugin marketplace add bitwise-media-group/skills
    /plugin install workflow@bitwise
    ```

=== "Codex CLI"

    ```sh
    codex plugin marketplace add bitwise-media-group/skills
    codex plugin add workflow@bitwise
    ```

=== "OpenCode / Antigravity"

    ```sh
    git clone https://github.com/bitwise-media-group/skills
    ./skills/install.sh --global   # links every skill, this plugin's included
    ```

See [Install](../../install.md) for scopes and options.

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`workflow-commit`](workflow-commit/index.md) | Commit changes the way a sandboxed agent must. |
| [`workflow-security-report`](workflow-security-report/index.md) | Triage a GitHub code-scanning (CodeQL) finding and produce an immutable Markdown triage report plus an index row, recommending remediation or dismissal, with a permalink pinned to the finding's commit SHA for every code reference so the report stays valid after the code moves. |
| [`workflow-skill-evals`](workflow-skill-evals/index.md) | Write the evolve evaluation suite for an agent skill: its triggers (triggers.json — Tier 1 activation tests) and behavioral evals (evals.json — Tier 2 task tests), under evals/<skill>/. |

## Commands

Claude Code slash commands — thin entry points to the skills above.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `/workflow:commit` | Commit the current changes following the workflow-commit skill — Conventional Commit messages with a worktree-aware commit.sh signing handoff. |
| `/workflow:security-report` | Triage a GitHub code-scanning (CodeQL) finding and write an immutable SHA-pinned report plus index entry, recommending remediation or dismissal. |
